name: Motion Director Skill
purpose: Reviews and polishes motion design: runs motion QA, reads measured leads, inspects sheets and seams, critiques with evidence, revises single scenes and records an honest creative review without self-certifying.

compatibility.notes: Verification of audio still needs a listener.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Runs a local browser and ffmpeg.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
